triples.tail_surface: fitted with stop valves at the suction and discharge sides
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在吸入和排出侧安装截止阀
triples.evidence_text: Fuel oil pumps are to be fitted with stop valves at the suction and discharge sides.

triples.tail_surface: A relief valve is to be fitted on the discharge side
triples.evidence_text: A relief valve is to be fitted on the discharge side unless the pump is of the centrifugal type having shutoff head no greater than the design pressure of the piping system.

triples.tail_surface: discharge to suction side of the pump or into tank
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 排放至泵吸入侧或舱柜
triples.evidence_text: Where fitted relief valve is to discharge to suction side of the pump or into tank.

triples.tail_surface: means are to be provided to minimize the possibility of a filter or strainer being opened inadvertently
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 提供防止滤器意外开启的装置
triples.evidence_text: Where filters and strainers are fitted in parallel to enable cleaning without disrupting the oil supply, means are to be provided to minimize the possibility of a filter or strainer being opened inadvertently.

triples.tail_surface: fitted with means of depressurizing before being opened and venting before being put into operation
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 配备开启前泄压及投运前排气装置
triples.evidence_text: Where they are required to be opened for cleaning during operation, they are to be fitted with means of depressurizing before being opened and venting before being put into operation.
